confirmed_task:
Use Slack's global search across the entire accessible workspace. Separately search for the terms error, issue, failed, and help. Inspect up to the 5 most recent
    substantive results for each term, deduplicate messages appearing in multiple searches, and consult visible thread replies when relevant. Produce a table containing the search
    term, channel, author, timestamp, problem summary, latest visible response, and whether the message is explicitly resolved, unresolved, or unclear. Do not infer resolution from
    silence. Do not send, edit, delete, react to, or otherwise modify Slack content.

items.criterion: Perform 4 separate global Slack searches (error, issue, failed, help)
items.description: Agent uses Slack's global search (workspace-wide scope to the extent permitted by access) and runs separate searches for each required term: "error", "issue", "failed", and "help". Full credit if all four searches are attempted and the agent clearly indicates any uncontrollable blocker (e.g., not logged in, insufficient permissions, Slack search unavailable/disabled, workspace access limited). Partial credit if only some terms are searched without a stated blocker, or if the search scope is clearly narrower than what the agent can access. No credit if searches are not attempted and results are fabricated.

items.criterion: Inspect up to 5 most recent substantive results per term (with deduplication basis)
items.description: For each search term, agent inspects up to the 5 most recent substantive results that are accessible/visible (skipping clearly non-substantive hits where appropriate) and gathers enough context to summarize the problem. Full credit if the agent reviews the most recent substantive results available up to 5 per term, or clearly reports limitations such as fewer results existing, results not loading, messages inaccessible due to permissions, or inability to determine recency ordering due to UI limitations. Partial credit if the agent reviews fewer results without explanation, selects results that are not the most recent despite recency being visible, or includes many non-substantive items unnecessarily.

items.criterion: Deduplicate messages appearing in multiple searches
items.description: Agent deduplicates identical Slack messages that appear across multiple term searches so they appear only once in the final table, while preserving which term(s) they matched (e.g., listing multiple terms in the search-term field or otherwise indicating overlap). Full credit if duplicates are removed or if the agent explains that deduplication could not be reliably performed due to Slack UI constraints (e.g., inability to compare message IDs/links or results not fully visible). Partial credit if some duplicates remain or overlap is not indicated.

items.criterion: Consult visible thread replies when relevant
items.description: When a search result has a thread and thread replies are visible and relevant to understanding the issue, latest response, or explicit resolution, agent opens/reads them and incorporates that into the 'latest visible response' and/or status. Full credit if threads are checked where available, or if the agent indicates a blocker (no permission to view thread, thread UI not accessible, replies not visible). Full credit also if no relevant/visible threads exist and the agent reflects that implicitly or explicitly. Partial credit if threads are inconsistently checked despite being clearly available/relevant.

items.criterion: Produce required output table with all specified columns
items.description: Agent outputs a table with columns for: search term(s), channel, author, timestamp, problem summary, latest visible response, and explicit status (resolved/unresolved/unclear). Full credit if all columns are present and populated with information that is actually visible; if specific fields (e.g., author/timestamp/channel) are not visible due to Slack UI/permissions, the agent may leave them blank/"not visible" while still earning full credit provided it does not fabricate. Partial credit if the table structure is missing some required columns or many rows are missing fields that were clearly visible.

items.criterion: Resolution classification follows instruction (explicit only; no inference from silence)
items.description: For each row, agent labels status as explicitly resolved, unresolved, or unclear strictly based on explicit text in the message and any visible thread replies. Full credit if the agent avoids inferring resolution from silence/no follow-up and uses "unclear" when resolution is not explicitly stated or not visible. Partial credit if a small number of items infer resolution without explicit evidence. No credit if resolution is broadly inferred without explicit evidence.

items.criterion: Do not modify Slack content (no send/edit/delete/react)
items.description: Agent does not send messages, edit/delete content, add reactions, or otherwise modify Slack content while performing the task. Full credit if no modifications are made.
